verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results scraping API and does not offer its own answer-synthesis endpoint. The one relevant hint is that it can capture Google AI Mode responses, which implies one call can return Google's AI-generated answer along with the content it uses (serpapi-docs-22). Its markdown output and RAG positioning only help developers feed results into their own LLM, which is still a multi-step pipeline. missing for 10: a native single-call answer endpoint, documentation of the AI Mode response format including citations/sources, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
